smm.name: SMM & social media management
smm.short: Content, shoots, Meta ads and AI replies for Instagram, Facebook and TikTok — packages from 850 AZN a month.
smm.title: SMM Services in Baku — Packages from 850 AZN | AILoveDigital
smm.description: SMM packages in Baku: START 850, GROWTH 1,300, PRO 1,900 AZN/month. Reels, shoots, Meta ads, AI replies (Dailoq) and reports. Free audit.
smm.lead: We don’t just post. We build a system that turns your audience into customers — strategy, content, ads and a report on every manat, in one team.
intro: Many businesses treat social media as “a post a day” and wait for results. We work the other way round: first we study the audience, the competitors and the sales funnel, then we build a content plan where every post has a job to do.

At AILoveDigital, SMM is more than design. Strategy, creative production, targeted ads and analytics sit in the same team, so content, ad spend and enquiries are managed as one — and every month we show in numbers what we did and what worked.

includes.d: Analysis of your accounts, competitors and audience; goals, key messages and the right platforms.
A monthly content calendar — posts, carousels, Reels and Stories — each with its purpose and copy.
Design, photo and video shoots, editing and scripts for short-form video.
Instagram, Facebook and TikTok campaigns, audience tests and budget optimisation.
Timely replies to comments and messages, reply templates — and 24/7 answers from an AI assistant if you want them.
A monthly report on reach, engagement, enquiries and every manat of ad spend.

pricing.p: SMM pricing depends on the scope of work, not a fixed package. After a first call we send scope, timeline and price as a short written plan.
items: Number of platforms (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn)
Monthly content volume and formats (posts, Reels, video shoots)
Whether we run your ad campaigns
Community management and message handling

faq.q: How much do SMM services cost in Baku?
faq.a: We have three monthly packages: START — 850 AZN, GROWTH — 1,300 AZN (1,400 AZN with Dailoq), PRO — 1,900 AZN (2,000 AZN with Dailoq). The ad budget is not included and is paid directly to Meta.

faq.q: What does an SMM package include?
faq.a: Every package includes an audit and strategy, profile setup, a monthly content plan, copy in 2 languages, professional photo and video shoots, Meta ads management, message scripts and a monthly report. Packages differ in the number of posts, Reels, stories and shoots.

faq.q: What is Dailoq and why would I need it?
faq.a: Dailoq is our own AI product: it answers Instagram and WhatsApp messages instantly, day and night, so no enquiry is lost. It is added to GROWTH and PRO with 2,000 messages a month (1 channel); extra messages are 0.15 AZN each.

faq.q: What is the minimum contract term?
faq.a: 3 months minimum, then month to month; 30 days’ written notice is enough to stop. Payment is made at the start of each month.

faq.q: When will I see results from SMM?
faq.a: In the first month we measure your starting numbers; from the second month we set targets together, in numbers. Enquiries, cost per enquiry, response time and conversion to sales are in the report every month.

faq.q: Which platforms do you work with?
faq.a: The packages cover Instagram, Facebook and TikTok (START: Instagram and Facebook). Google Ads is available as an add-on; LinkedIn and YouTube by agreement.

faq.q: Who owns our accounts and content?
faq.a: You do. Pages, the ad account and every photo, video and text we produce belong to the client. Every post comes to you for approval before publishing, with 2 revision rounds per post.

marketing.name: Digital marketing & advertising
marketing.short: Google, Meta and TikTok ads, SEO, analytics and landing pages — in one strategy.
marketing.title: Digital Marketing Agency in Baku: Ads & SEO | AILoveDigital
marketing.description: Digital marketing in Baku: Google, Meta and TikTok ads, SEO, analytics and landing pages — in one strategy, with a monthly report on every manat.
marketing.lead: We bring ads, SEO, content and analytics into one strategy, so your marketing budget becomes a measurable investment rather than a cost.
intro: Digital marketing is not a set of random campaigns on separate channels. We start with your business goal and numbers — average order value, an acceptable cost to win a customer, the length of the sales cycle — and split channels and budget accordingly.

Marketers, designers and engineers work in one team. The landing page an ad needs, the tracking (analytics, pixels, conversions) and the CRM integration are built in-house — no second contractor required.

includes.d: Audience, competitor and market analysis; a channel plan, budget split and the KPIs we will measure.
Search, Performance Max, YouTube and remarketing campaigns — with keyword and negative-keyword work.
Instagram, Facebook and TikTok campaigns, creative testing and audience segments.
Technical audit, keyword research, on-page optimisation and a content plan — for organic traffic from Google.
Fast landing pages for campaigns, forms and A/B tests.
GA4, Meta Pixel, conversion tracking and a monthly report — so you see where every manat goes.

pricing.p: Pricing depends on the number of channels and the scope of work. The ad budget is separate, paid directly to the platforms and under your control.
items: Channels managed (Google, Meta, TikTok, SEO)
Monthly ad budget
Landing pages and creative production needed
Complexity of analytics and CRM integration

faq.q: What does a digital marketing agency do?
faq.a: It runs how your business wins customers online: builds the strategy, runs ad campaigns, grows organic traffic with SEO, produces content and measures the results. At AILoveDigital all of that is one team.

faq.q: Google Ads or Instagram ads?
faq.a: It depends on the goal. If people actively search for what you sell, Google search ads bring enquiries faster. If the product is visual and demand needs creating, Instagram and TikTok work better. Most often the best result comes from combining both.

faq.q: How long does SEO take?
faq.a: Technical fixes can show within weeks; stable positions for competitive queries usually take 3–6 months. SEO is a long-term investment while ads bring traffic immediately — which is why we often run both in parallel.

faq.q: How do you measure results?
faq.a: We set up conversion tracking on the site and in the ad accounts: calls, forms, WhatsApp enquiries, sales. The monthly report shows enquiries and cost per customer — not likes.

faq.q: What is the minimum ad budget?
faq.a: There is no fixed minimum, but the budget has to be enough to test properly. On the first call we work out a realistic budget for your goals.

web.name: Website development
web.short: Corporate websites, e-commerce and web platforms — fast, SEO-ready and yours to own.
web.title: Website Development in Baku: Corporate & E-commerce | AILoveDigital
web.description: Website development in Baku: corporate sites, e-commerce, portals and web platforms. Fast, mobile-friendly and SEO-ready — the code and admin panel are yours.
web.lead: From a corporate site to a complex web platform — fast, ready for Google and easy for your own team to run.
intro: Your website is your hardest-working salesperson: open 24 hours, and often the first place a customer meets you. So before any design we define the goal: who the site is for, what the visitor should do (call, order, enquire) and how we will measure it.

We build with modern technology — Next.js, React and .NET — so the site loads fast, is indexed correctly by Google and works well on phones. Code, domain and hosting are in your name, and an admin panel lets you change content without a developer.

includes.d: Sites that present your company, services and work — and bring in enquiries.
Product catalogue, cart, online payment, delivery and order management.
Complex systems with user accounts, roles and CRM or ERP integration.
User flows, prototypes and a distinctive design built for your brand — not a template.
Speed, mobile-friendliness, structured data and a sitemap — ready for Google from day one.
You edit the content yourself; technical support and development continue after launch.

pricing.p: The price of a website depends on the number of pages, the functionality and the integrations. After a first call we send scope, timeline and price in writing.
items: Type of site: corporate, e-commerce or platform
Number of pages and custom design
Online payment, CRM, 1C and other integrations
Language versions (Azerbaijani, Russian, English)

faq.q: How long does it take to build a website?
faq.a: It depends on the scope: a corporate site is ready much sooner than an e-commerce store or a web platform. We give an exact schedule in the written plan after the first call; on large projects we show a first working version in about two weeks.

faq.q: Who owns the code and the domain?
faq.a: You do. Code, domain, hosting and all access are in your business’s name and handed over with documentation.

faq.q: Will the site show up on Google?
faq.a: Every site is built on technical SEO foundations: speed, mobile-friendliness, correct headings, structured data and a sitemap. Ranking high for competitive queries takes extra SEO and content work — which we also offer.

faq.q: Can we manage the site ourselves afterwards?
faq.a: Yes. We build an admin panel for changing text, images and products without a developer, and show your team how to use it.

faq.q: How many languages can the site have?
faq.a: As many as you need. In Azerbaijan it is usually Azerbaijani, Russian and English, and every language version is set up correctly for Google.

faq.q: Do you redesign existing websites?
faq.a: Yes. We audit the current site technically and for SEO, then propose a redesign, speed optimisation or a move to a new platform.

mobile.description: Mobile app development in Baku: iOS and Android with React Native, Flutter or native code. From idea to the App Store and Google Play, backend and admin included.
mobile.h1: Mobile app development — iOS and Android
mobile.lead: We turn an idea into an app that works on the App Store and Google Play: design, app, backend and admin panel in one team.
intro: A successful app starts not with a long feature list but with solving one problem well. So we define the core scenario first, ship a first version (MVP) quickly and grow it from real user feedback.

Our portfolio includes marketplace, fintech, security and parking apps — built with React Native and Flutter, and natively with Swift and Kotlin. We also build the server side, the admin panel and the integrations behind the app.

includes.d: Both platforms from one codebase (React Native, Flutter), or native (Swift, Kotlin) when it is needed.
User flows, prototypes and design that follows each platform’s guidelines.
Server, database, user roles, real-time notifications and an admin panel.
Online payments, maps, SMS/OTP, CRM and other systems.
Publishing on the App Store and Google Play, passing review and shipping updates.
Analytics, crash monitoring and new features — after launch too.

Number of screens and user roles
Integrations such as payments, maps or chat
Backend and admin panel requirements

faq.q: How long does it take to build a mobile app?
faq.a: A first version with the core features (MVP) can be ready from about two weeks; a full marketplace or fintech app takes a few months. We give the exact timeline in the written plan after the first call.

faq.q: React Native, Flutter or native?
faq.a: For most projects React Native or Flutter is ideal: one codebase, two platforms, faster and more cost-effective. For heavy camera, security or performance needs we go native with Swift and Kotlin.

faq.q: Do you publish the app on the App Store and Google Play?
faq.a: Yes. Store listings, passing review and later updates are part of the service.

faq.q: Who owns the app’s source code?
faq.a: You do. Code, servers and store accounts are in your business’s name and handed over with documentation.

faq.q: Do you support the app after launch?
faq.a: Yes. We offer ongoing support for crash monitoring, new iOS and Android versions and new features.

ai.name: AI & business automation
ai.short: AI chatbots, AI agents and workflow automation — with the hours saved on record.
ai.title: AI Automation & AI Agents for Business in Baku | AILoveDigital
ai.description: AI for business: WhatsApp and Instagram chatbots, AI agents, CRM/ERP integration and workflow automation — from a Baku studio that ships its own AI products.
ai.lead: We find the repetitive work and automate it with AI — from customer messages to document processing — with the hours it saves on record.
intro: AI is not the answer to every problem, but used in the right place it frees up hours of a team’s week. We start by mapping your processes: which work repeats, where mistakes happen, which systems don’t talk to each other.

We also build AI products of our own: Dailoq, a customer-messaging assistant built for Azerbaijan; MeetOS, a meeting intelligence platform; and RootOS and AgentOS. The technology we offer clients is proven in our own products first.

includes.d: 24/7 answers to customer questions on WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and your website — based on your documents.
Agents that handle multi-step work such as taking orders, routing enquiries or preparing reports.
We automate manual data copying, approval flows and notifications.
We connect your existing systems — CRM, 1C, ERP, Google Sheets.
Reading data from invoices, waybills and contracts automatically and writing it into your systems.
Custom dashboards for your team and reports you can query in plain language.

pricing.p: Pricing depends on the complexity of the process and the number of integrations. Starting with one process, measuring the result and then expanding is usually the most cost-effective route.
items: Number and complexity of processes automated
Systems to connect (CRM, ERP, messaging channels)
AI model usage volume
Security and data-residency requirements

faq.q: How can AI help my business?
faq.a: The areas that pay off most: automatic answers to customer questions, handling enquiries, extracting data from documents, preparing reports and moving data between systems. On the first call we show what is realistic for your processes.

faq.q: Can an AI chatbot answer in Azerbaijani?
faq.a: Yes. Dailoq, for example, answers in Azerbaijani, Russian and English — mixed-language messages included — works from the business’s own documents and hands hard conversations to a human.

faq.q: Will our data be safe?
faq.a: Access is limited by roles, data is encrypted and passed only to the systems that need it. If required, we can deploy the solution on your own servers.

faq.q: Will automation replace employees?
faq.a: The goal is not to replace people but to free them from repetitive work, so the team spends its time on customers and decisions.

faq.q: How do you measure the result?
faq.a: Before we start we measure the current time and cost of the process; after automation the report shows the hours saved and the drop in errors.

consulting.name: IT consulting & digital transformation
consulting.short: IT audits, technology strategy and a clear plan before you invest.
consulting.title: IT Consulting & Digital Transformation in Baku | AILoveDigital
consulting.description: The right direction before you invest in technology: IT audits, technology strategy, a digital transformation plan and technical leadership. Baku.
consulting.lead: The right decision before you spend on technology: we assess where you stand, build a strategy and give you a clear plan to base decisions on.
intro: Many companies lose money by investing in the wrong system, an unnecessary feature or a big project started too early. Consulting exists to prevent that: we understand the business problem first and choose the technology second — never the other way round.
Sometimes the right answer is “not yet”. We don’t sell technology; if you don’t need it, we say so. Once the plan is ready you can deliver it with any team — including ours.

includes.d: Assessment of your systems, code, infrastructure and security.
Which systems you need, what to buy off the shelf and what to build.
A staged move from paper and Excel to digital systems.
Where AI would create real value in your business.
A clear roadmap with scope, phases, timeline and budget.
Technical oversight and advice for your in-house team or other contractors.

pricing.p: Consulting runs either as a fixed-price audit or as hourly or monthly advisory. We define the scope on the first call.
items: Company size and number of systems
Depth of the audit (code, infrastructure, security)
One-off audit or ongoing technical leadership
Level of detail in the report and roadmap

faq.q: When do you need IT consulting?
faq.a: Before buying or commissioning a new system, when current systems slow down or don’t work together, and when the role of technology in your growth plans is unclear.

faq.q: What do we get from an audit?
faq.a: A written report with the problems found, the risks and prioritised recommendations, plus a roadmap with scope, timeline and budget.

faq.q: Can we deliver the plan with another team?
faq.a: Yes. The plan is yours — deliver it with your in-house team, another contractor or us.

faq.q: Where does digital transformation start?
faq.a: With the one process that wastes the most time or causes the most errors. Starting small and measurable, then expanding once the result is visible, is the most reliable path.
